'''2012 Worlds Day 2 Ziemowit Skwara DS Ralltiir Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Ziemowit Skwara]] at [[2012 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Player:''' [[Ziemowit Skwara]]
* '''Event:''' [[2012 World Championship]]
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' [[Ralltiir Operations / In The Hands Of The Empire]]
* '''Username:''' Kryptofis
* '''Stage:''' Day 2
